    How it works

    From request to estimate in four steps

    1. I

      Describe your project

      The service, property type, location and the timing you have in mind.

    2. II

      Add photos & video

      For cleaning, three photos and a short walkthrough video help the provider see the scope.

    3. III

      Connect with a provider

      We match your request with a suitable reviewed provider who covers your area.

    4. IV

      Discuss the estimate

      The provider reviews your request, quotes the work and confirms availability with you.

    Request an estimate

    Request an in-person estimate

    Tell us where cleaning is needed and when your manager can meet on-site. Submit your request and our janitorial team will follow up to confirm the estimate visit.

    • Business locations: include whether you have in-house cleaners, your legal business name, and the name and work contact details of the manager who can attend.
    • Available time slots: share two dates and time windows when your manager can meet, including the property's timezone. Our team will confirm the visit with you.
    • What helps most: three clear photos and one short walkthrough video.
    • No media yet? Send your request anyway and we'll arrange the next step with you.
    • Private by default: your photos, address and contact details are shared only with the provider reviewing your request.

    The team reviews your request and confirms the representative and time for the in-person estimate. The provider quotes and performs the work under its own agreement with you. Sending a request doesn't confirm a booking or a final price.

    Tell us about your project

    For a business request, add your in-house cleaning setup, legal business name, manager details and two available time slots for the in-person estimate in Additional Details or Comments. Include the timezone. Keep the estimate visit separate from your preferred cleaning start date; the team will confirm the appointment.

    Our standards

    Approval is earned, never bought

    Before a provider is published, our team reviews who they are and what they do. Every profile states what was checked, where the information came from, and when.

    What we review

    Business identity, the services offered, the areas actually covered, references, and any licenses or insurance documents that apply to the work.

    Where it comes from

    Ratings and reviews are shown with their source and the date we checked them. We don't publish ratings we can't trace.

    What approval means

    Approval means the review was completed. Sponsored placement is labeled separately, and a paid membership never changes an approval decision.

    Reviewed before published
